items.title: Everest Group (EG) Stock Gains Ground Despite Q3 Results Margin Squeeze
items.summary: Everest Group just reported Q3 2026 and the headline is simple. Earnings power held up. Insurance profitability did not. The stock still climbed 2.6% today to about US$411, extending a strong month into a green reaction day. Investors focused on resilient after tax operating earnings and record net investment income.
